kept.title: The chase is for an idea
kept.gist: Reframe the chase so the bad guys are after what's inside the device. What she protects is an idea, not a gadget.
kept.why: from Tue 0:05: “opens up the device in her hands”

board.hook: Everyone wants what's in her hands

kept.title: Separate voices, one connected idea
kept.gist: Each creator speaks a fragment on their own. On screen, the fragments link into a single finished idea none of them said alone.
kept.visual_query: different rooms, close voices, warm lamps
kept.why: from Mon 0:01: “the hook being that the ideas are connected”

kept.title: The launch video made by the device
kept.gist: Show the chase scene starting life as a spoken note into the device, then becoming the finished launch film. The ad proves itself.
kept.visual_query: late night desk, low light, scribbles
kept.why: from Mon 0:00: “I'm thinking of an idea where we have Arabella”

board.hook: This launch video started as one sentence

kept.title: Six-second teaser: just the radio line
kept.gist: A cold-open teaser with almost no picture: static, breathing, then the radio line. It drops before the full launch video.
kept.visual_query: black frame, radio static, heavy breath
kept.why: from Tue 0:05: “radios through and says, I've got it”

kept.title: The seamless flow, mapped step by step
kept.gist: Map each handoff in the short video so every cut lands on the next stage, from the device in hand to the finished video.
kept.why: from Mon 0:40: “make the product, then the AI, and then the output”
